story: Barbarika & The 3 Arrows: Bound by a vow to his mother to support the losing army, supreme archer Barbarika heads to Kurukshetra with just 3 divine arrows. Lord Krishna, disguised as a Brahmin under a sacred Peepal tree, challenges him to pierce every leaf of the tree while secretly stepping on one leaf. Barbarika's first arrow marks all leaves with vermilion and hovers at Krishna's foot. Realizing Barbarika's paradoxical vow would annihilate both armies, Krishna requests his head as sacrifice, which Barbarika offers willingly, becoming immortalized as Khatu Shyam.
